parts.label: Universal slotted joint-test base
parts.purpose: 170 x 100 mm base with M3 grid and four M5 bench-fixing holes.

parts.label: Adjustable F695ZZ test bearing tower
parts.purpose: Pair supports an independent M5 output shaft; mounting grid allows variable spacing.

parts.label: MG996R sliding test cradle
parts.purpose: Allows direct-drive pitch-joint torque and speed testing while adjusting servo alignment.

parts.label: MG90S sliding gear-test cradle
parts.purpose: Adjustable center distance for J1 and J4 gear-pair efficiency/backlash tests.

parts.label: 150 mm calibrated torque arm
parts.purpose: Weight/load-cell holes every 10 mm from 20 to 150 mm; connects to M5 split hub.

parts.label: Universal small load-cell adapter
parts.purpose: Adapter has multiple M4/M3 candidate holes; final pattern must be matched to the selected load cell.

parts.label: M5 shaft encoder magnet holder
parts.purpose: Holds nominal 6 mm diametric magnet; slit and cross screw retain holder on M5 shaft.

parts.label: Guarded test-weight hook
parts.purpose: Connects calibrated weights to TR05; keeps weights from sliding off during static torque tests.
